title: About Us | Lalitpur Financial Advisory Nepal
metaDescription: Learn about Lalitpur Financial Advisory: our mission, values, ethical standards, and transparent management consulting practice serving all 7 provinces of Nepal.
directAnswer: Lalitpur Financial Advisory is an independent financial and business management consultancy founded to deliver rigorous, transparent, and forward-looking financial stewardship to enterprises and individuals across Nepal. We adhere strictly to ethical consulting standards, distinguishing management advisory from ICAN statutory audits.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Editorial Board

sections.contentHtml: Nepal's commercial ecosystem is maturing rapidly. Growing businesses need sophisticated financial stewardship to navigate credit markets, tax laws, and cash volatility. Our mission is to provide arithmetic-grounded financial advice that helps founders, directors, and families build enduring commercial strength.

1. Absolute Transparency

We provide candid assessments of financial health. We never fabricate credentials, exaggerate outcomes, or make speculative return guarantees.

2. Statutory Compliance

We operate strictly within Nepalese legislation: the Companies Act 2063, Income Tax Act 2058, and Local Government Operation Act 2074.

3. Client Confidentiality

Every engagement is governed by non-disclosure agreements protecting proprietary ledgers, customer pricing, and commercial strategies.

Professional Delineation: Lalitpur Financial Advisory is an independent management consulting firm. In accordance with the Nepal Chartered Accountants Act 2053, statutory independent external audits are reserved exclusively for licensed members of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nepal (ICAN). Our consultancy assists clients with internal controls, accounting readiness, and audit file compilation, but does not issue statutory audit reports or legal court advocacy.

faqs.question: What credentials do your advisors possess?
faqs.answer: Our advisory desk comprises professionals with master's degrees in business administration, finance, and corporate management, alongside experienced accounting practitioners. Our advisory team combines advanced qualifications in corporate finance, managerial economics, accounting workflows, and Nepalese statutory compliance. We assign dedicated advisory specialists based on your sector and project scope.
